title: system-design-expert→implementer handoff record (design-block)
description: Single JSONL record appended to .scratch/handoff.jsonl by system-design-expert after design validation, or after a build-failure escalation. Carries the architectural guidance that feature-implementer needs to write tests and code without re-deriving package placement, integration points, or design risks. Conservative required-field set; grow on observed retry deltas.

type.description: Discriminator. Always "design-block" for this record type.

req_id.description: Requirement ID linking this design back to the prd-entry.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was appended.

author.description: Pinned to system-design-expert for this record type.

verdict.description: Triage outcome. covered → existing durable memory handles this slice, implementer proceeds with pointers to relevant sections; minor → small adjustment to an existing pattern, implementer proceeds; new → genuinely new design ground for this slice, design work and possibly an ADR accompany this record, implementer proceeds; foundational → project-level foundational gaps surfaced, durable-memory writes (system-design.md, ADRs, ubiquitous-language.md) and a user dialogue happened before this verdict was finalized, implementer proceeds in the populated context; conflicting → this slice conflicts with current design, route blocks (design-conflict) and surfaces the escalations to the user; refactor-first → an independently-meaningful refactor must land before this slice can be implemented, system-design-expert appends a refactor prd-entry alongside this design-block, the router orders the refactor slice through the pipeline first, and this slice resumes after the refactor lands.

architectural_fit.description: How the feature integrates with the existing design. Plain prose; references docs/system-design.md sections where relevant.

primary_paths.description: Paths the feature primarily lives in. At least one. Implementer reads this as the starting target set.

supporting_paths.description: Other paths touched (helpers, fixtures, related tests). Optional.

integration_points.description: Component-to-component connections introduced or changed. One entry per integration. Optional but recommended when the feature crosses module boundaries.

patterns.description: Existing code patterns to follow. Each entry references a file:line and explains the pattern.

risks.description: Identified design risks and their mitigations. Optional.

escalations.description: Items requiring human decision. Required when verdict is "conflicting".

supersedes_record_at.description: When this record revises a prior design-block (e.g., after a build-failure escalation), the line number (1-indexed) of the prior record this revision supersedes. Append-only is preserved; this is a back-reference, not an edit.

notes.description: Free-form context that doesn't fit other fields. Avoid as a dumping ground.
